vulnerability.name: USN-5478-1
vulnerability.description: Christian Moch and Michael Gruhn discovered that the libblkid library of util-linux did not properly manage memory under certain circumstances. A local attacker could possibly use this issue  to cause denial of service by consuming all memory through a specially crafted MSDOS partition table.

statements.status_notes: A util-linux program could be made to crash if it opened a specially crafted file system. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
